answer: Make each seat continuously prove a distinct physical location. The agent signs ambient RF fingerprints, cell-tower IDs, WiFi BSSIDs and GNSS Doppler, then answers a beacon nonce only a real antenna at that geometry can return in time. Clones sharing one box read the same fingerprint and collapse to one seat; a receiver on a coastal wharf and one on the open tundra see provably different skies. No ivory-tower abstraction: N seats means N physically separated time-synced antennas. Limit: SDR replay can spoof a static map, so the live Doppler challenge, not the fingerprint, carries the weight.
